name: The Ral Nel Consortium
_setNote: Introduced in Thunder's Edge — available whenever rules/gameMode.ts's own hasThundersEdge(gameMode) is true.

startingTechnologyChoice.note: Choose 1 red OR green technology with no prerequisites.

factionAbilities.name: SURVIVAL INSTINCT
factionAbilities.effect: After a player activates a system that contains your ships, you may move up to 2 of your ships into the active system from adjacent systems that do not contain your command tokens.

factionAbilities.name: MINIATURIZATION
factionAbilities.effect: Your structures can be transported by any ships; this does not require or count against capacity. While your structures are in the space area, they cannot use their unit abilities. At the end of your tactical action, you may place your structures that are in space areas onto planets you control in their respective systems.

versions.effect: You may move your structures from adjacent systems that do not contain your command tokens onto planets you control in the active system. Then, return this card to the Ral Nel player.

factionTechnologies.name: Nanomachines
factionTechnologies.effect: ACTION: Exhaust this card to place 1 PDS on a planet you control. ACTION: Exhaust this card to repair all of your damaged units. ACTION: Exhaust this card and discard 1 action card to draw 1 action card.
factionTechnologies.note: 3 separate exhaust-triggered component actions on the same card — only 1 of the 3 can be used per exhaustion, same as any other exhaust-gated tech ability.

breakthrough.name: Data Skimmer
breakthrough.effect: During the action phase, if you have not passed, when other players would discard action cards, they are placed on this card instead. When you pass, take 1 action card from this card and discard the rest.

flagship.name: Last Dispatch

abilities.name: Scorched Retreat
abilities.effect: When this unit retreats, you may destroy 1 ship in the active system that does not have SUSTAIN DAMAGE.

flagship.faq: If the Ral Nel player plays the action card Skilled Retreat, they cannot resolve Last Dispatch's own Scorched Retreat ability for that same movement (Skilled Retreat is not treated as "this unit retreats" the normal way, per Skilled Retreat's own confirmed ruling that it isn't a retreat at all).

abilities.name: Reinforcement Route
abilities.effect: At the end of a round of combat on this planet, you may move up to 2 of your ground forces to this planet from planets in adjacent systems.

destroyer.name: Linkship
destroyer.note: Ral Nel Destroyers can use the SPACE CANNON ability of structures they carry (via the Miniaturization faction ability) and are faster than regular destroyers.

abilities.name: Borrowed Cannon
abilities.effect: This unit can use the SPACE CANNON ability of one of your structures in its space area; each structure can only be triggered once.

abilities.name: Borrowed Cannon
abilities.effect: This unit can use the SPACE CANNON ability of one of your structures in its space area; each Linkship can trigger the same structure.
abilities.note: Unlike Linkship I, multiple Linkship IIs CAN all trigger the SAME single structure's Space Cannon (confirmed FAQ example: 1 PDS + 8 Linkship IIs = 8 total Space Cannon shots, since up to 8 destroyers can be on the board at once).

agent.name: Kan Kip Rel
agent.ability: ACTION: Exhaust this card to draw 2 action cards; give 1 of those cards to another player.

commander.name: Watchful Ojz
commander.unlock: Be the last person to pass during the Action Phase.
commander.ability: When you declare a retreat: Immediately retreat up to 2 of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. Place a command token from your reinforcements into that system.
commander.faq: This commander ability and the normal ANNOUNCE_RETREAT/retreat-at-end-of-round mechanic are separate: the 2 ships move immediately upon declaring the retreat via Watchful Ojz, and the REST of the player's ships still retreat normally at the end of the combat round — either to the SAME system the commander-moved 2 went to, or to a different one, the player's choice either way.

hero.name: Director Nel
hero.effect: After the last player passes: You may choose to no longer be passed; if you do, gain 2 command tokens, draw 1 action card, and purge this card.

faq: Up to 8 destroyers can be on the board for a single player at once — with 1 PDS and 8 Linkship IIs, each Linkship can trigger that SAME PDS, producing 8 total Space Cannon shots.

No official ruling/errata yet on whether Linkships with the PDS II unit upgrade can fire Space Cannon against ADJACENT systems (Space Cannon normally only fires within its own system) — per tirules2.com (an unofficial 3rd-party source, not yjmrobert.com), the current unofficial consensus is that Linkships cannot fire Space Cannon at adjacent units even with PDS II owned. Flagged as unresolved/unofficial rather than treated as settled.
